children: American depositary receipts of Scorpio Gold pared some of their gains after more than doubling before an earlier trading halt, which the company later said was done in error.
The ADRs were up 51%, to US$7.67, after being halted at US$11.66 earlier Wednesday, their second day trading on Nasdaq.
The company Wednesday afternoon said the trading halts were imposed in error and requested that the ADRs and common shares resume trading.
The Nasdaq and CIRO halts were characterized as halts due to pending news.
Prior to the halts Wednesday, Scorpio reported favorable results from the Phase Two drill program at the Manhattan District Project in Nevada.
The TSXV-listed shares were up 17%, to 42 Canadian cents, after trading resumed late Wednesday afternoon. Meanwhile, Scorpio's OTCQB-listed shares were 25% higher, at 30 U.S. cents.
